subject: Everything is read-only
body: This morning none of us can edit anything in Pharos. There's a banner saying the workspace is read-only. I think my card expired last week. I updated it an hour ago but we still can't edit, and my team is just sitting here.

subject: offline on the phone app
body: My crews work in buildings with no signal. Is there any way the mobile app can work offline and sync later? Right now they write stuff on paper and re-enter it.

subject: Due dates not on my Google Calendar
body: I connected my Google Calendar last week but none of my task due dates are showing up on it. I'd really like to see them next to my meetings.

subject: too many attempts
body: It says too many attempts and won't let me in. I'm presenting the project plan to a customer in 20 minutes and it's all in there.

subject: Nonprofit pricing?
body: We're a volunteer-run free clinic (501c3) using the trial to organize our outreach events. Is there any discount for nonprofits before we commit to a plan?

subject: emails going to junk
body: A couple of people on my team said the emails from Pharos land in their junk folder, so they miss when they're assigned something. Anything I can do?

subject: close account
body: Retiring at the end of the year. Please close my account and delete everything when the time comes. Thanks for the good service.

subject: video won't attach
body: I'm trying to attach a 250 MB video file to a task for client review and it just says Upload failed every time. Smaller images work fine.

subject: 400 emails overnight?!
body: Everyone on my team woke up to hundreds of Pharos emails, one for every single comment on our big launch project. People are furious and some are talking about turning email off entirely. What happened and how do I stop this?

subject: reuse our refund requests board
body: We have a project called Refund Requests with columns we really like. Can I reuse that setup for new projects so I don't rebuild it every time?

subject: Billed for wrong plan
body: We're on the Team plan but this month's invoice charged us $20 per person for Business. We never upgraded. Please correct it.

subject: Login I don't recognize
body: Under recent activity I see a login from another country at 2am yesterday. That wasn't me or anyone on my team. What should I do?
